status: EXACT SOFTWARE GRAPH COUNTS + PARAMETERIZED ESTIMATES; NO FULL NETWORK RTL, EFINITY OR BOARD RESULTS
hardware_facts: HARDWARE_INPUT.md (user supplied); Ti60F225I3-V4 DEMO; DDR3 MT41J128M16JT-125 x16 800MT/s, 256MiB; AXI100MHz width UNKNOWN

assumptions.requant_note: Unverified partial-product scheduling assumption; scalar requant may require LUT/add/shift resources and more cycles. No INT8 packing assumed.
assumptions.bandwidth: min(1.6GB/s,AXI_bits/8*100MHz)*eff - 55.296MB/s; no peak bandwidth equated to measured throughput
assumptions.traffic: unfused operator tensor reads/writes plus80px internal column halo estimate. Each layer weights+quant fit32KiB resident cache. Two16KiB banks act as one32KiB cache for large layers, so next-layer prefetch overlap is not assumed. Pointwise conv caches all input channels of a column; depthwise processes channel groups. AXI padding/turns/port packing remain unverified.
assumptions.fusion: block/stripe fusion is a future optimization, NOT implemented or included as a throughput claim
assumptions.RISC_V: if used, softcore with LE/BRAM cost; no free core assumed

external_physical_buffers.allocation_note: Three physical raw slots: admitted/current, complete latest pending, DMA write. Only ONE pending frame; atomic slot swaps prevent tearing. No unbounded FIFO.

limitations: No synthesis, timing closure, DSP primitive mapping, BRAM port/block packing, DDR benchmark or board throughput.
Native binary executes in CPU reference; RTL loader/engine remains unimplemented.
INT64 CPU interpreter scratch is not FPGA storage; deployment activations are UINT8 and accumulators INT32.
No fullres15fps claim; reduced internal resolution must be labeled.
